transitions.caption: Factorial opens into a fresh procedure for 3.
3 enters n; fresh 3s appear where the binding is used.
3 is not zero, so the base branch closes.
Factorial opens into a fresh procedure for 2.
2 enters n; fresh 2s appear where the binding is used.
2 is not zero, so the base branch closes.
Factorial opens into a fresh procedure for 1.
1 enters n; fresh 1s appear where the binding is used.
1 is not zero, so the base branch closes.
Factorial opens into a fresh procedure for 0.
0 enters n; fresh 0s appear where the binding is used.
At zero, the recursive branch closes.
The base value 1 returns into the waiting multiplications.

accessibleDescription: Factorial of three repeatedly opens its procedure and leaves multiplication waiting until factorial of zero reaches the base value one. The results then return through one times one, two times one, and three times two, producing six.
